notes: scripts v6: pre-seeds the OneBot config for the new bot account 411649762 at stack start. NapCat keeps per-account configs (onebot11_<QQ>.json under rootfs/root/NapCat.linux.arm64/config); install_env only seeded the old account 3322592972, which QQ risk control has now flagged, so the bot is being moved to a new account. start_qqbot.sh now, after its path variables are set and before NapCat launches, copies the base onebot11.json to onebot11_411649762.json when that file is missing (an existing per-account file is never overwritten; a missing base only logs a warning and the start continues). All other scripts are byte-identical to scripts v5 (self-detaching fast stop with one-pass /proc sweep and start-tick guard), and bot stays v6: ranked candidate fallthrough (up to 3 candidates tried silently; dead_source, failed, blocked, or link-less candidates are skipped for the next; the group sees one searching message plus the final link or one honest all-sources-failed reply), empty-search retry (up to 2 re-runs at ~6s gaps), 21:00-23:59 Asia/Shanghai digest poster, single-instance lock, message_id dedup, video-over-novel pick.
